patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed image still reaches the `X86_BNDSTXmr` printer path, but its `printanymem()` initializes `MI->x86opsize` before `printMemReference()` copies the field into `MI->op1_size`, so the sink executes without an uninitialized-byte read.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: On the `X86_BNDSTXmr` path, the one-byte `MI->x86opsize` field that `printMemReference()` will copy into `MI->op1_size` must already be initialized before control leaves the `printanymem()` switch.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed source initializes `MI->x86opsize` on the same `X86_BNDSTXmr` printer path before `printMemReference()` executes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches `op1_size_sink` with `bndstx_memsize_root.x86opsize_initialized_prefix_len = 0` and `x86opsize_read_bytes = 1`, so the required predicate is violated while the protected sink executes. The fixed original reaches the same protected sink with `x86opsize_initialized_prefix_len = 1` and `x86opsize_read_bytes = 1`, making the required assertion genuine.

nodes.description: At the MSAN sink, the `if (MI->op1_size == 0)` guard consumes the same one-byte `MI->op1_size` field with zero initialized bytes available on the vulnerable `X86_BNDSTXmr` path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_sink.op1_size_initialized_prefix_len = 0` and `op1_size_sink.op1_size_read_bytes = 1` immediately before the sink read.

nodes.description: Immediately after `printMemReference()` executes `MI->op1_size = MI->x86opsize`, the destination byte `MI->op1_size` is still uninitialized on the vulnerable `X86_BNDSTXmr` path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_copy.op1_size_initialized_prefix_len = 0` and `op1_size_copy.op1_size_store_bytes = 1` immediately after the copy.

edges.description: The same `MI->op1_size` field written in `printMemReference()` is the field read immediately afterward at the `printOperand()` sink on the `X86_BNDSTXmr` path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_copy.op1_size_field_addr == op1_size_sink.op1_size_field_addr == 0x7ffcc2e96f7e`.

edges.description: The exact `MI->x86opsize` field left uninitialized at the `printanymem()` root site is the source operand that `printMemReference()` copies into `MI->op1_size` on the same `X86_BNDSTXmr` path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `bndstx_memsize_root.x86opsize_field_addr == op1_size_copy.x86opsize_field_addr == 0x7ffcc2e972a0`.
